Use case: stylized-concept. Create a HIGH RESOLUTION raster concept board for a faithful HD reinterpretation of the Allods Java ME fantasy RPG's SMALL UI ICONS. The input pictures are original-game visual references ONLY, not edit targets. Keep the distinctive original silhouettes, not a generic mobile MMO. Art direction: hand-painted late-1990s Eastern European fantasy RPG inventory art, carefully drawn beveled silhouettes, oxidized bronze and warm antique gold against charcoal slate and black, cool worn steel, restrained emerald accents. Rich high-resolution brush detail inside bold readable silhouettes, slightly grim and grounded, no pixel art, no blur, no vector-flat style, no glossy plastic, no sci-fi, no purple loot frames. Upper-left light. This is a concept BOARD, opaque charcoal background. Output large square high-res image, preferably 2048 by 2048 or larger.
EXACTLY 36 generous equally sized cells in a straight 6 columns x 6 rows grid, balanced margins, thin discreet stone separators. Each cell contains one centered standalone icon, occupying about 70% of the cell. Do not scatter decorations between cells. No captions, no lettering, no digits, no watermark.
ROW 1 SIX ORIGINAL COMBAT ACTIONS in this precise left-to-right order: diagonal steel sword attack; embossed circular bronze rune walking/movement; orange-gold kite shield defense; curved gold back arrow; golden arcane compass emblem magic; wood longbow shooting.
ROW 2: small triangle up; triangle down; triangle left; triangle right; original ornate gold right-pointing selection cursor; gold checkmark accept.
ROW 3: ornate back/cancel hooked arrow; gold X close; gold plus; gold minus; brass scrollbar thumb; gold down chevron more text.
ROW 4: folded parchment world map; tiny red party pennant; bronze outlined map cursor ring; small gold unselected circular map node; emerald selected map node; iron lock unavailable.
ROW 5: leather bound quest journal; closed leather inventory satchel; rolled character sheet with cameo; gold coin pile; wooden iron-bound chest; antique musical note.
ROW 6: matching empty dark square icon slot; selected square slot with thin emerald inner edge; unavailable gray square slot; five tiny circular empty sockets arranged horizontally as ONE symbol; same five sockets with colored crystals as ONE symbol; narrow green and blue HP/MP double gauge as ONE symbol, with worn dark metal border and no digits.
Keep every pictogram readable when reduced to 32-48 pixels. Equal visual weight. UI frame specimens in bottom row are simple and functional, do not use ornate decorations that eat the icon area. This sheet establishes the common material and lighting language for the following portrait, spell and item boards.

Retain differences between the two helmeted men. Do not turn the skeleton into a dragon. Equal 3x3 grid with no text.
